KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_DRUMMAG: Significantly increases magazine capacity by attaching a drum mag. However, it must still be reloaded a couple of bullets at time.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_MORERELOAD: Increases the number of bullets loaded at a time, reducing reload time.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_SCOPED: Adds a scope to the weapon, allowing it to be fired from a scoped view.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_INCENDIARYGR: Adds an incendiary compound to the projectile, causing it to spread fire when detonating on ARC.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_CHARGEDBURST: Changes the firing mode to charge and release. The longer the charge is held, the more projectiles are fired upon release.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_FULLAUTO: Makes the weapon fully automatic, at the cost of accuracy and stability.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_CARBINECONVE: Repurposes the Canto as a carbine, greatly improving stability and accuracy at the cost of agility.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_SPRINTSHOOTI: Ergonomic fittings that allow the weapon to be comfortably fired while sprinting.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_RAMPINGDAMAG: Gradually increases the Equalizer's damage while its laser remains in contact with a valid target.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_INCREASEDBUR: Increases the number of projectiles fired within a burst.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_INCENDIARYRO: Adds an incendiary compound to the projectile, setting targets on fire when hit.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_PROJECTILESP: Replaces the Anvil's bullets with rounds that split into four weaker projectiles.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_STRAIGHTBOLT: Ergonomic bolt that allows the user to perform the bolt-action while scoped.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_MAGRELOAD: Removes the need to reload one projectile at a time.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_HIGHVELOCITY: Increases the velocity of the projectile fired.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_BURSTFIRE: Makes the weapon fire in a burst.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_TRACKERROUND: Replaces the bullets with tracker rounds that briefly reveal the position of targets they hit.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_ANTIWEAKPOIN: Deals increased damage to ARC weak points, but deals less damage to ARC armor plating.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_SLUGROUNDS: Replaces the normal shotgun shells with a single large projectile that deals massive damage.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_XROUNDS: Adds an explosive compound to the projectile, dealing slightly increased damage to Raiders and significantly increased damage to ARC Armor plating.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_ACSENDEDUPGRADE_ANTISHIELD: Redistributes damage to prioritize breaking shields faster.
